<div class="billsplit-copy">
<p class="billsplit-eyebrow">PASSPHOTO <span aria-hidden="true">·</span> FOR IPHONE</p>
<h1 id="passphoto-title">Passport photos.<br><span>Right the first time.</span></h1>
<p class="billsplit-description">Take or choose a photo, pick your document, and PassPhoto crops it to that document’s official rules for 46 countries and areas, plus the international ICAO standard. Faces are never retouched; the photo check runs on your iPhone or with Apple’s Private Cloud Compute. Optional support tips use Apple’s in-app purchase system.</p>

<a class="billsplit-contact-button" href="mailto:passphoto@flycricket.support">Contact support <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>
<p class="billsplit-support-note">Questions or feedback? <a href="mailto:passphoto@flycricket.support">passphoto@flycricket.support</a></p>

<section class="billsplit-steps" aria-label="How PassPhoto works">
<article>
<span class="billsplit-step-number">01</span>
<div><h2>Pick your document</h2><p>Choose from 63 documents across 46 countries and areas, each with its official rules and source.</p></div>
</article>
<article>
<span class="billsplit-step-number">02</span>
<div><h2>Take or choose a photo</h2><p>The guided camera tells you when everything lines up.</p></div>
</article>
<article>
<span class="billsplit-step-number">03</span>
<div><h2>Check, save and print</h2><p>Review the photo against the document rules, then save it or make a 4×6 print sheet.</p></div>
</article>
